calibration.reason: Clear labels and legibility support the task, while the familiar layout limits originality and misplaced focus after invalid input impairs recovery.

primary_action.input: Tab to the 6 m footbridge row, then Enter.
primary_action.expected: Set 6 m and show the path and footbridge closed and the ferry stopped.
primary_action.observed: The value became 6 m; all three statuses updated. Captures: A-1440-before and A-1440-after.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab twice and Enter set 2 m. The path was closed; ferry and footbridge remained listed as level not reached.
A-1440.fact_check: The waterline aligns with the 6 m mark and the text reports 6 m. Thresholds and statuses are internally consistent; real-world closure thresholds were not independently verified.
A-1440.strength: The large cross-section and adjacent status rows make the relationship between elevation and closures easy to inspect.
A-1440.weakness: The rows look like status output, so their direct-jump button behavior is not obvious before keyboard focus.
A-1440.repair: Make the threshold rows visibly actionable while preserving their status labels.

primary_action.input: Tab to the 6 m footbridge row, then Enter.
primary_action.expected: Set 6 m and show all three closure outcomes.
primary_action.observed: The value became 6 m and the three outcomes were readable in the first 390 × 844 viewport. Captures: A-390-before and A-390-after.

A-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab twice and Enter set 2 m. Only the path was marked closed; the other two rows said level not reached.
A-390.fact_check: The waterline meets the 6 m tick, matching the displayed value. Actual local closure thresholds were not independently verified.
A-390.strength: The complete illustration, control, and three status rows fit in the first viewport.
A-390.weakness: The cross-section labels are small, and the final row sits close to the viewport bottom.
A-390.repair: Increase diagram label legibility and provide more breathing room without pushing the results below the fold.

primary_action.input: Tab to the selected 4 m radio, then ArrowRight.
primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and list all three closures.
primary_action.observed: 6 m became selected and the list showed the path, ferry and footbridge outcomes. Captures: B-1440-before and B-1440-after.

B-1440.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses selected 2 m and the list contained only Riverside path closes.
B-1440.fact_check: The waterline aligns with the 6 m threshold and the heading says 6 m. Actual local closure thresholds were not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The distinct level choices, high-contrast results and detailed cross-section create a clear task flow.
B-1440.weakness: The ferry and pedestrian remain drawn at their fixed threshold positions beneath the waterline, which can distract from the status explanation.
B-1440.repair: Clarify that the drawing depicts fixed closure elevations, or adapt the figures to the selected state.

primary_action.input: Tab to the selected 4 m radio, then ArrowRight.
primary_action.expected: Select 6 m and show the complete closure result.
primary_action.observed: 6 m became selected; all three results and the cross-section were readable in the first 390 × 844 viewport. Captures: B-390-before and B-390-after.

B-390.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses selected 2 m and the list contained only the path closure.
B-390.fact_check: The blue waterline meets the 6 m tick and agrees with the result heading. Actual local closure thresholds were not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The controls and result precede the diagram, making the answer immediately accessible without scrolling.
B-390.weakness: The compressed diagram makes the small illustrations and the wrapped Riverside path label less clear.
B-390.repair: Simplify the mobile illustration or enlarge its labels while retaining the visible result above it.

preference.reason: Both designs complete the tested keyboard task and fit the results in the tested mobile viewport. B makes the level choices and current result more explicit, places the answer before the diagram on mobile, and filters the 2 m list to the one applicable closure.

decision: The large threshold views scored 8.75 at both widths, ahead of stock and below round 5. Retain round 5 and close the stepped-bank series.
